title: Hearty Slovakian Pork Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring charred and fluffy dumplings with a rich red pepper paste sauce, perfect for a comforting dinner. This recipe is low in sodium and can be adjusted to suit various tastes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, red pepper paste, flour, eggs, onion, garlic, paprika, and black pepper, and mix until just combined.
Do not overmix the dumpling mixture.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small dumplings, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each dumpling.
Bake the dumplings in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are cooked through and lightly browned on the bottom.
While the dumplings are baking, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add a small amount of oil to the pan.
Once the oil is hot, add the baked dumplings to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are nicely browned.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite sides, such as mashed potatoes or steamed vegetables.
